newsitem.title: UK: BZW appoints new European money markets head.
newsitem.headline: BZW appoints new European money markets head.

text.p: Investment bank BZW said on Wednesday it had appointed Andrew Lubin as head of its European money markets.
BZW said it had created the position as part of the reorganisation of its European Government Bond business.

Lubin will be responsible for matched book repo trading, funding positions, market making of short end securities and global product management across all European currencies, including emerging markets.
He worked at Morgan Stanley in New York before joining CSFB in London in 1992 where he was head of repo trading.
